'''West Massir''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Southern Eanif Ocean]] to the west and south, the [[Ksisahi Sea]] and [[North Massir]] to the north, and [[South Massir]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|5,767,689|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 10th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 1,035,587,381 as of 1765, making it also the largest sub-continent by population.
